author: Craig A. M. et al.

author: Souza R. G. et al.

title: Difference-in-Differences for Health Policy and Practice - PMC
author: Wing C. et al.

title: Regression Discontinuity Designs in Epidemiology - PMC - NIH
author: Bor J. et al.

notes: PMC epidemiology methods paper — strong scope-qualifier patterns (local to cutoff).

title: [2002.02770] A Survey on Causal Inference
author: Guo R. et al.

title: Difference-in-Differences Designs: A Practitioner's Guide
author: Roth G. et al.

notes: Recent arXiv DiD methods guide — strong on limitations of canonical DiD.

title: Regression Discontinuity Designs in Economics
author: Lee D. S., Lemieux T.

title: Instrumental Variables: An Econometrician's Perspective - NBER
author: Heckman J. J., Urzua S.

title: Why null results do not mean no results: negative findings
author: Bastian H. et al.

title: Reporting and interpretation of results from clinical trials that did not claim

title: Evidence of Lack of Treatment Efficacy Derived From Statistically  - PMC

title: Promoting Learning from Null or Negative Results in  - PMC
author: Rohrig B. et al.

notes: PMC article on publishing null prevention-science findings.

title: Promoting Learning from Null or Negative Results in Prevention
author: Sedgwick P. et al.

title: Evaluating the replicability of social science experiments in
author: Camerer C. F. et al.
